chapter: Kid Ory band personnel and repertoire
title: Lionel Reason and other Ory pianists
summary: The interviewer asks about pianist Lionel Reason, whom Smith doesn't recall.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: There was several piano players out there that I think about. Like, I don't suppose you ever knew Lionel Reason. No, I don't remember that name. He lived in California for a while and he was with Ori and, well, previously he'd been with King Oliver. No, he'd been way back. Way back.
In the 30s and I knew him down here
and I understand he's back in Baton Rouge.
